summary: We have created a Minecraft map with data and a resource pack designed to promote education, which could one day become a valuable part of Minecraft Education Edition. It is incredibly important to make education accessible and fun. Thanks to our teamwork, excellent communication, and effective division of labor, we have successfully overcome this challenge.
details: A lot of people around the world play Minecraft. Every child or teenager has Minecraft. That means if you create a map in Minecraft, kids can play on it. But you have to make sure it’s not too boring—it should be interactive and playful. That was our thinking.
